population.what: the stored 2xx item pages of the CPD-0039 / CPD-0040 study
population.exclusion_rule: every page of the 2026-11-15 review sample (109 rows) and every page this run opened one by one while repairing the rules (DEVELOPMENT_PREFIXES of the script)

limits: the rules were repaired on aggregate measurements of this same population (all pages), so the control is independent of the cases the rules were tuned on, not of the population: it is not fresh data
the random component (n=24) supports coarse statements only (e.g. 24 of 24 agreements: 95 % lower bound about 0.86); the targeted strata find errors and do not estimate population precision
BODY questions judge the extracted text shown, so they are not blind to the extraction itself; every other question is asked without the machine's answer

strata.method: systematic sample with a random start over the eligible pages ordered by country, outlet and sha256(seed + fetch id); inclusion probability n / N for every page

questions.TITLE: a letter of the candidate that is this article's headline as the page prints it; N if none is
questions.SUBTITLE: the number(s) of the block(s) that are the article's subtitle / standfirst (comma-separated); 0 if none
questions.CORE: yes | no | unsure  (a complete Spanish press text of running prose, at least 150 words; not a live ticker, list, page frame, paywall or login stub, page about the publication, or paid content -- provenance does not matter)
questions.IPTC: the IPTC Media Topics top-level code(s) the published section label names (e.g. 15000000), comma-separated; none if the label names no topic or is ambiguous
questions.AI_TEXT: generated | assisted | translated | unclear | none  (what the page declares about AI use for the article text)
questions.AI_COMPONENT: summary | audio | image | none  (AI-made parts beside the article the page declares; comma-separated)
questions.AGENCY_ROLE: credited | co_credited | material_source | quoted_only | none  (comma-separated if several)

definitions.credited: the agency is named as author or source of the published text (author field, byline, wire dateline, credit)
definitions.co_credited: the agency is credited together with the outlet's newsroom or the publisher
definitions.material_source: the agency is named as the source of material the text uses ('Con información de EFE')
definitions.quoted_only: the agency is only quoted in the running text as a source ('según la agencia EFE'); nothing credits it
definitions.exact: the same text, word for word, with the same punctuation and case (paragraph breaks and spacing may differ)
definitions.near_identical: almost the same text throughout: a changed opening or close, a sentence or a few words different
definitions.contained: the shorter text stands (almost) entirely inside the longer one, which has substantial further text
definitions.partial_overlap: a substantial shared passage, but neither of the above
